action: Returned in person to Betty Kowalski's diner and closed $120/month social media contract; Betty's RoboRide delivery menu pivot created direct opening; TikTok post published for lead generation
narrative: Zoe walked into the diner at 2:30pm on a Tuesday, sat across from Betty Kowalski, and made the direct ask — Betty said yes within four minutes. Betty had just signed up her diner with RoboRide's restaurant delivery program and was staring at a new delivery menu she had no idea how to promote online, and Zoe's timing was almost absurd in its precision. The contract is $120/month starting immediately, one post per day focused on the delivery menu and community warmth. Miguel Hernandez had separately texted Zoe with a referral — a woman named Carmen who runs a small alterations shop on Market Street and has been asking around about social media help — which arrives as the second confirmed lead in the pipeline. Zoe posted the before-and-after TikTok comparing businesses that went dark on social versus ones that stayed visible, and it received 340 views and 6 DMs by end of the tick.
